ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_FactTOTALRELATIONSHIPBALANCE] AS
BEGIN

WITH TRB AS (
--SELECT [BusinessDateSK], [BranchSK], [BankSK], [AccountSK], [AccountID], [BalanceAmountFull], [BalanceAmountProrated] 
--FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance
--
--UNION ALL
--
--SELECT [BusinessDateSK], [BranchSK], [BankSK], [AccountSK], [AccountID], [PortfolioEndValueFull], [PortfolioEndValueProrated] 
--FROM DW.FactSecurityPortfolio

SELECT [BusinessDateSK], DFAD.[BranchSK], DFAD.[BankSK], DFAD.[AccountSK], DFAD.[AccountID], [AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull], [AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated] 
FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD DFAD
JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON DFAD.AccountSK = DDA.AccountSK
WHERE DDA.AccountStatus not in ('Closed')

UNION ALL

SELECT [BusinessDateSK], [BranchSK], [BankSK], [AccountSK], [AccountID], [AUMAmountFull], [AUMAmountProrated] 
FROM DW.FactTrustFundValue

UNION ALL

SELECT [BusinessDateSK], [BranchSK], [BankSK], [AccountSK], [AccountID], [OutstandingInvestmentFull], [OutstandingInvestmentProrated] 
FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment  ) 

INSERT INTO DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance
(
 [BusinessDateSK]
,[BranchSK]
,[BankSK]
,[CustomerSK]
,[CustomerID]
,[FullMarketSegmentSK]
,[ProratedMarketSegmentSK]
,[TotalRelationshipBalanceFull]
,[TotalRelationshipBalanceProrated]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm]
)
SELECT 
 TRB.[BusinessDateSK]
,TRB.[BranchSK]
,TRB.[BankSK]
,TRB.CustomerSK
,TRB.CustomerID
,CASE WHEN DMSF.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND TRB.TRBAmountFull >= 10000000 THEN 7     
      WHEN DMSF.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND TRB.TRBAmountFull < 1 THEN 1 ELSE DMSF.MarketSegmentSK END AS FullMarketSegmentSK
,CASE WHEN DMSP.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND TRB.TRBAmountProrated >= 10000000 THEN 7 
      WHEN DMSP.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND TRB.TRBAmountProrated < 1 THEN 1 ELSE DMSP.MarketSegmentSK END AS ProratedMarketSegmentSK
,TRB.TRBAmountFull
,TRB.TRBAmountProrated 
,TRB.SourceSystemCode
,TRB.WorkFlowId
,TRB.TaskRunId
,TRB.InsertDttm
FROM
 (
        SELECT 
          TRB.[BusinessDateSK]
        , NULL [BranchSK]
        , TRB.[BankSK]
        , DCA.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
        , DCA.CustomerID AS CustomerID
        , SUM([AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull]) AS TRBAmountFull
        , SUM([AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated]) AS TRBAmountProrated 
        , DC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
        , 0 AS WorkFlowId
        , 0 AS TaskRunId
        , Getdate() AS InsertDttm
        FROM TRB
        LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON TRB.AccountSK = DCA.AccountSK
        LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK
        WHERE DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
        GROUP BY 
         TRB.[BusinessDateSK]
        ,TRB.[BankSK]
        ,DCA.CustomerSK
        ,DCA.CustomerID
        ,DC.SourceSystemCode
) TRB
LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMSF ON ISNULL(TRB.TRBAmountFull,0) >= DMSF.LowerLimit AND ISNULL(TRB.TRBAmountFull,0) < DMSF.UpperLimit
LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMSP ON ISNULL(TRB.TRBAmountProrated,0) >= DMSP.LowerLimit AND ISNULL(TRB.TRBAmountProrated,0) < DMSP.UpperLimit
WHERE TRB.CustomerSK IS NOT NULL 

END
GO
